# Turn meeting notes into action items with an owner and a date

> Paste meeting notes or a transcript and get action items with owner and due date, decisions and open questions, plus a follow-up email. Free, private, no upload.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/meeting-action-items/)
- [How to write meeting action items that get done](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/meeting-action-items/how-to-write-meeting-action-items.html)
